config.label: Your TwittrAPI key
config.description: Your TwittrAPI key. Set this or RAPIDAPI_KEY.

config.label: RapidAPI key for the Twitter AIO API
config.description: RapidAPI key for the Twitter AIO API. Used when TWITTRAPI_API_KEY is not set.

config.label: Host of your TwittrAPI listing on RapidAPI
config.description: Host of your TwittrAPI listing on RapidAPI. Change it if you subscribed to another listing.

config.label: Format of tool results: simple (compact JSON, far fewer tokens) or raw (X's full GraphQL JSON)
config.description: Format of tool results: simple (compact JSON, far fewer tokens) or raw (X's full GraphQL JSON). Tools also take a format argument.

config.label: Cookie of your own logged-in x
config.description: Cookie of your own logged-in x.com session (auth_token, ct0, twid). With TWITTRAPI_X_PROXY set, adds the account tools (post, like, follow, DMs, lists, drafts).

config.label: Your proxy for the account tools, http://user:pass@host:port
config.description: Your proxy for the account tools, http://user:pass@host:port.

config.label: Your X Chat passcode
config.description: Your X Chat passcode. Adds send_dm and message text in the DM inbox.
